v08_model.note: Learned from paired audio. It does not expose original plugin knobs or guarantee transfer to another take.

v09_model.features: 10ms dry+processed levels; 1/4/12/35 frame smoothed envelopes; slopes; three band ratios
v09_model.note: Predictions use dry and prior-output only, not reference; source v08 phase FIR is noncausal.

prior_v10_model.note: Reference is required to FIT but never read while RENDERING. Model has lookahead. Not a native VST3.

prior_v11_model.caveat: EQ values were chosen after inspecting the Deuce reference and multiple sections; NOT blind validation. Reference is used only to fit, not render.

v12_base.caveat: Model deliberately learned from one vocal take. Evaluation sections were inspected during development; not independent blind validation. Post-saturation threshold was selected after inspecting multiple passages, including evaluation windows; these are not truly held-out test results.

post_saturation.note: Chosen after inspecting Deuce evaluation passages; not blind validation.

v13A_prior.note: Offline, reference-inspired model. Not a proprietary plugin reconstruction.

note: Only training window used for fitting. Middle and later passages were inspected during development, so not independent blind validation.
